author: KEXP
description: Ambient artist Julianna Barwick and harpist Mary Lattimore immerse listeners in meditation with their joint album 'Tragic Magic.' Live on KEXP with host DJ Cheryl Waters, they share serenity with a performance of "Melted Moon" and more.
title: Julianna Barwick and harpist Mary Lattimore perform "Melted Moon" & more Live on KEXP
